title: [LinuxBSD] Add support for HDR output (Wayland)
orig_rationale: Large Wayland HDR output feature (14 files, new color-management protocol, Vulkan driver changes); foundational for 117702/117530 but big and unverified on linuxbsd.

title: Add taskbar progress and state support for Windows & macOS
orig_rationale: Adds taskbar progress/state API to DisplayServer + Window for macOS/Windows; additive and macOS-compilable, but it is a new cross-platform API (servers/display, scene/main/window, docs) rather than a fix. Defer as a feature; mechanical FOUNDRY_CLASS/rebrand adaptation needed.

title: Apple: Support output to EDR (HDR) displays
orig_rationale: Large EDR/HDR output feature (24 files) touching Metal/Vulkan drivers, iOS/visionOS, and renaming display_server_embedded->display_server_macos_embedded with big display_server_macos refactors. Foundational for several later HDR/embedded PRs but a heavy, risky feature port; sequence deliberately.

title: Core: Restructure sanitizers
orig_rationale: Restructures sanitizer defines (SANITIZERS_ENABLED -> per-sanitizer) across core/typedefs.h and all platform detect.py incl. macOS; cross-platform build/core change, verify macOS impact before porting.

title: Add pointer warping on wayland
orig_rationale: Adds Wayland pointer warping via new pointer-warp protocol (new thirdparty files, SCsub); feature not build-verified on linuxbsd.

title: [DisplayServer] Add per window icon support.
orig_rationale: Cross-platform per-window icon feature adding new DisplayServer virtuals (linuxbsd/windows/servers); broad API surface, affects base class implemented on macOS.

title: Wayland: Implement touch support
orig_rationale: 452-line new Wayland touch-input feature across embedder/thread/display server; sizable, not build-verified on linuxbsd.

title: Add support for picture-in-picture
orig_rationale: Adds picture-in-picture: new public DisplayServer virtuals/enum and MainLoop/Node PIP notifications, implemented only on android. Broad new public API surface for android-only value; port-later.

title: Android: Add export options to customize splash screen
orig_rationale: Adds export options to customize the android splash screen. Feature touching the diverged export_plugin.cpp plus new assets; android export not build-verified.

title: Fix fallback to OpenGL3 from Vulkan initialization on Android.
orig_rationale: Adds Vulkan->OpenGL3 fallback on android by threading a RenderingSource through OS::set_current_rendering_driver_name/method, changing signatures at every platform display-server call site and reworking main.cpp. Broad cross-platform signature change; high ripple for android-only value.

title: iOS: Allow building with `opengl3=no`
orig_rationale: Guards iOS OpenGLES code behind GLES3_ENABLED so iOS can build with opengl3=no; iOS is not compiled by the macOS build, so not verifiable here. Defer.

title: Add device orientation change signal to DisplayServer
orig_rationale: Adds an orientation_changed signal to DisplayServer, wired on android and apple_embedded. Small and mostly build-verifiable, but a new public-API feature (not a bugfix) with low value for the fork.

title: Android: Allow implementing java interfaces from GDScript
orig_rationale: Lets scripts implement Java interfaces via JavaClassWrapper (C++ java_class_wrapper + AndroidRuntimePlugin). Feature (unblocks #119601/#119634); gd test assets are N/A to Foundry Script, and android side is not build-verified.

title: GLES3: Split EGL includes in `platform_egl.h`
orig_rationale: Splits EGL includes into per-platform platform_egl.h (new file absent in base) across GLES3/EGL plumbing; GLES3 is not the fork's primary macOS path, refactor is not build-verifiable and touches diverged driver code.

title: Disable FP contraction (iOS/visionOS)
orig_rationale: Disables FP contraction for iOS/visionOS detect.py to match macOS; iOS/visionOS are not compiled by the macOS build, so not verifiable here. Low-risk parity fix, defer.

title: Android: Add support for plugins gradle platform dependencies
orig_rationale: Adds support for android plugin gradle platform dependencies (app/build.gradle). Build-config feature, not build-verified.

title: [macOS] Add build name to bundle ID.
orig_rationale: Appends build name to bundle ID and switches to get_version_info, but platform_macos_builders.py is heavily fork-diverged (Foundry rebrand, get_build_version helper, no org.godotengine.godot string); needs manual adaptation, low value.

title: Fix OpenXR with Vulkan on Android
orig_rationale: Fixes OpenXR with Vulkan on android (display_server_android + java_godot_lib_jni). XR-specific, rebranded JNI tree, not build-verified.

title: OpenXR: Fix OpenGL initialization with Monado on X11
orig_rationale: OpenXR OpenGL/Monado X11 init fix adding new DisplayServer virtual and gl_manager hooks; touches modules/openxr and servers/display, cross-cutting and unverified on linuxbsd.

title: [Windows] Implement OneCore TTS support using C++/WinRT (no deps).
orig_rationale: Large OneCore TTS feature: adds WinRT build, refactors tts_windows into SAPI/OneCore drivers, and touches core/os/spin_lock.h. Windows-only new feature, defer as a deliberate feature port.

title: [Windows] Use OneCore/WinRT emoji picker when available.
orig_rationale: WinRT emoji picker; introduces winrt_utils and depends on the WinRT build support absent in base. New feature, defer with the WinRT chain.

title: Wayland: Deduplicate cleanup logic
orig_rationale: Deduplicates Wayland cleanup logic (-212 lines); pure refactor, low value, not build-verified on linuxbsd.

title: Android: Only poll for devices when a runnable export preset is configured
orig_rationale: Only polls for devices when a runnable export preset is configured. Base already carries a related has_runnable_preset implementation but not this _start/_stop refactor, so it is a divergent partial; reconcile before porting.

title: Wayland: Fix race with buffer scaling
orig_rationale: Fixes buffer-scale race by threading buffer_scale through WindowRectMessage; moderate wayland_thread change, unverified on linuxbsd.

title: [Web] Fix assertions wrongly affecting release template, make it configurable
orig_rationale: Makes web Emscripten assertions configurable; web build-script only, not compiled/verifiable in macOS build.

title: [Linux] Improve crash trace symbols
orig_rationale: Improves crash symbols (-f -p -C) and drops -rdynamic in detect.py; depends on addr2line chain (115566/117067) and changes linker flags, unverified on linuxbsd.

title: Android editor: Enable orientation change in Script Editor
orig_rationale: Enables orientation change in the android Script Editor; adds a distraction_free_mode_changed signal to editor_node.cpp. editor_node.cpp is heavily fork-diverged (multi-scene workspace), conflict risk, android-only value.

title: Android: Fix FileAccess crash when using treeUri in Gradle-built apps
orig_rationale: Fixes a FileAccess crash with treeUri in Gradle-built apps via gradle dependency/config changes only. Build-config change, not verifiable in this macOS build.

title: Android: Add haptic feedback on long-press right-click in the editor
orig_rationale: Adds haptic feedback on long-press right-click in the android editor, plus a new EditorSettings entry. Adds a shared editor setting for an android-only behavior; low value, not build-verified.

title: Only attempt to load ANGLE DLLs from executable folder.
orig_rationale: Restructures ANGLE init with EGL_STATIC macro branches and its surrounding context assumes the 4.7 two-arg set_current_rendering_driver_name (RENDERING_SOURCE_FALLBACK) absent in base; subtle, Windows-only, not compiled here.

title: [Windows] Set current driver when ANGLE init fails.
orig_rationale: Calls set_current_rendering_driver_name(driver, OS::RENDERING_SOURCE_FALLBACK); base OS only has the single-arg setter and no RENDERING_SOURCE enum. Blocked on 4.7 rendering-source-tracking API.

title: Android export: Add error message when ETC2/ASTC compression is not enabled
orig_rationale: Adds a cmdline-mode error explaining ETC2/ASTC compression is required for android export. Genuinely missing from base and small, but lands inside the fork's heavily trimmed export_plugin.cpp and cannot be build-verified; low-risk nice-to-have once placement is confirmed.

title: Android: Bump the minimum api version and hardware version for Vulkan support
orig_rationale: Bumps minimum API/hardware for Vulkan support (export_plugin + gradle/manifest + Godot.kt). Config/policy change; android not build-verified.

title: Wayland: Improve mapping robustness and synchronization
orig_rationale: 227-line Wayland mapping robustness/synchronization rework; broad and subtle, not build-verified on linuxbsd.

title: [macOS/Windows] Remove dynamically linked ANGLE support, add flag to enable/disable ANGLE.
orig_rationale: Large ANGLE build reorg (remove dynamic linking, add enable flag, install_angle.py, glad patch) plus CI workflow edits; fork's ANGLE detect.py and CI are diverged and ANGLE is not built/verified here. High conflict, low value.

title: Misc includes or modernize fixes found via clangd-tidy
orig_rationale: Broad 48-file clangd-tidy modernization spanning platform/scene/servers/tests; no functional change but high merge friction against fork divergence. Defer and apply opportunistically.

title: Wayland: Only report HDR request failed warning if HDR was actually requested
orig_rationale: Blocked: guards HDR-request warning in window_request_hdr_output, which is absent in base (depends on HDR PR 102987).

title: [Android] Follow up fixes to enabling orientation change in the script editor
orig_rationale: Follow-up fixes to script-editor orientation change (title-bar toggle JNI). Android-editor-only, depends on #117109, touches editor JNI + rebranded Kotlin.

title: [Android] Fix handling of back navigation when targeting API level 36
orig_rationale: Fixes back-navigation handling when targeting API level 36. Android runtime behavior plus instrumented tests in the rebranded Kotlin tree; not build-verified.

title: Fix plugin signal registration error on Android
orig_rationale: One-line plugin signal registration fix in Godot.kt, later reworked by #119233. Part of the android plugin-signal cluster; rebranded Kotlin, port the cluster together.

title: [Android] Clean up `Godot.kt`
orig_rationale: Splits Godot.kt into a GodotNativeBridge (moves ~400 lines, touches java_godot_lib_jni/java_godot_wrapper). Large refactor over the tree the fork already rebranded to java_foundry_*; high mechanical rework, not build-verified.

title: Wayland: Fix use-after-free of `Ref<ColorManagementProfile>`
orig_rationale: Blocked: fixes UAF of Ref<ColorManagementProfile> in HDR color-management code that does not exist in base (depends on HDR PR 102987).

title: [Windows] Remove polling of SDR white level when HDR output is enabled.
orig_rationale: Optimizes SDR-white-level polling in the 4.7 HDR-output path (_get_screen_hdr_data/_update_hdr_output_for_tracked_windows) which does not exist in base; blocked on HDR-output feature.

title: Wayland: Unify clipboard sending code
orig_rationale: Deduplicates Wayland clipboard send code; pure refactor, low value, not build-verified on linuxbsd.

title: macOS: Fix embedded window scaling issues when hiDPI is disabled
orig_rationale: Embedded game window hiDPI scaling fix, but built on display_server_macos_embedded (renamed/refactored from base's display_server_embedded by #106814); blocked on that embedded rework.

title: [Apple, Wayland] HDR Output: Emit window events when HDR state changes
orig_rationale: Emits window events on HDR state changes; depends on the HDR/EDR output infrastructure that is absent in the fork base. Blocked on #106814 (f1ce0e6).

title: Wayland: Initialize libdecor earlier
orig_rationale: Reorders libdecor initialization; init-ordering change with subtle effects, not build-verified on linuxbsd.

title: [Windows] WinRT build improvements.
orig_rationale: WinRT build improvements (SCsub/detect.py/install_winrt.py); base has no WinRT build support, so this depends on the not-yet-ported WinRT infra.

title: Android: Remove deprecated Google Play OBB support
orig_rationale: Removes deprecated Google Play OBB/expansion/licensing support (54 files, ~9k deletions). Base 4.6.3 still ships OBB, so it is a genuine large removal; reasonable dead-code cleanup for the fork but spans the rebranded android tree and is not build-verified.

title: [ANGLE] Fix build with manually set path.
orig_rationale: ANGLE angle_path fallback depends on the 'env[angle]' + arch-suffixed angle_libs path structure introduced by #117445, which is absent in the fork's older ANGLE detect.py; blocked on #117445.

title: [Windows] Add support for `AdvancedColorInfo` info and change callback.
orig_rationale: Adds AdvancedColorInfo support requiring both winrt_utils (absent) and the 4.7 HDR-output infra (_get_screen_hdr_data/hdr_output_cache, also absent). Feature-dependent, not portable to base.

title: Warn only once when the input method stops
orig_rationale: Substantial restructure of X11 _create_xic/XIM callbacks to warn once; delicate IME area, overlaps _xim_destroy_callback with 118404, unverified on linuxbsd.

title: Allow moving and resizing the embedded game window on Android
orig_rationale: Adds move/resize of the embedded game window (large android-editor UI: layouts, drawables, EmbeddedGodotGame rework). Feature, android-editor-only value, rebranded tree, not build-verified.

title: Wayland: Handle complex pointer event frames
orig_rationale: Reworks Wayland pointer-frame event accumulation; delicate event handling, not build-verified on linuxbsd.

title: LinuxBSD crash handler: Move addr2line finding to its own function
orig_rationale: Extracts addr2line lookup into find_addr2line_executable(); depends on the addr2line chain (115566/117067/117060) landing first.

title: [WinRT] Wait for DispatcherQueueController shutdown.
orig_rationale: Edits winrt_utils.cpp (absent in base); part of the WinRT chain, blocked until winrt_utils lands.

title: Add a bunch of missing window existence checks to HDR methods
orig_rationale: Adds window-existence checks to HDR output methods, but HDR/EDR output infra (window_is_hdr_output_*) does not exist in the fork base; blocked on #106814 (f1ce0e6).

title: Fix embedded window minimum size bug on Android
orig_rationale: Clamps embedded-window min size and avoids divide-by-zero on aspect lock. Depends on the resize feature from #118417 (references MIN_WINDOW_SIZE/resizingEnabled/isFreeResize) which is not in base; rebranded editor-embed Kotlin.

title: Add missing `angle` check to MSVC branch.
orig_rationale: Adds `if env["angle"]:` guard, but base detect.py lacks the 4.7 `angle` BoolVariable and the ANGLE build restructure; heavily diverged Windows build tooling, no macOS impact.

title: [Windows] Fix OneCore TTS language code formatting.
orig_rationale: Touches tts_driver_onecore.cpp which is absent in base; blocked on OneCore TTS feature PR 116349 (0dabee).

title: [Web] Remove undefined behavior around exit
orig_rationale: Web-only exit UB/main-loop cleanup fix; self-contained but platform/web is not compiled or verifiable in the macOS editor build, so defer.

title: [Web] Remove flags that prevent `proxy_to_pthread` from building
orig_rationale: Removes web link flags blocking proxy_to_pthread; platform/web build-only, not compiled/verifiable here.

title: [Windows] Dynamically load `coremessaging`.
orig_rationale: Modifies winrt_utils.cpp which does not exist in base; part of the WinRT feature chain, blocked until winrt_utils is introduced.

title: Revert Android Editor minSdk bump to 24
orig_rationale: Reverts the android editor minSdk bump back to 24 (gradle/manifest/editor Kotlin). Config-only, pairs with #118942, android build not exercised here.

title: Android: Set the default minSdk for compatibility renderer to 24
orig_rationale: Uses DEFAULT_MIN_SDK_VERSION (24) for the compatibility renderer instead of the Vulkan minimum. Missing from base, but the fork's export_plugin.cpp is heavily diverged (~162 lines trimmed) and android export is not build-verified.

title: Wayland: Improve hovered window handling
orig_rationale: Large 575-line wayland_thread rework of hovered-window handling; broad and subtle, not build-verified on linuxbsd here.

title: Fix Android plugin issues
orig_rationale: Switches JNISingleton signals to add_user_signal and restores early plugin registration. Entangled with the 4.7 android signal-registration cluster (#117682/#119428) and the rebranded Godot.kt; port the cluster together after confirming the base regression.

title: [Windows] Force supported SDK with MSVC 2019, add Scons option to set SDK version.
orig_rationale: Introduces check_mssdk_version/mssdk option atop the 4.7 configure_msvc structure; base detect.py has diverged and lacks this infra. Windows-build-only, not compiled here.

title: [Android] Miscellaneous bug fixes
orig_rationale: Adds a taskAffinity manifest entry and a hasExtra guard in command-line arg parsing. Lands in the rebranded Godot.kt/manifest; low value and android-only, not build-verified.

title: Fix Android plugin signal regression
orig_rationale: Adds JNISingleton::_get so plugin signals resolve as Signal properties. Part of the 4.7 android plugin-signal rework; base 4.6.3 may not carry the underlying regression, so verify the bug exists before porting. Pairs with #119233/#117682.

title: [Windows] Remove `await` MSVC flags.
orig_rationale: Edits the SCsub `if env["winrt"]:` block which does not exist in base (no WinRT build support); blocked until the WinRT build chain (0dabee/f3dfd4) is ported.

title: [Windows] Check if used SCons version supports requested MSVC.
orig_rationale: SCons-version guard depends on 4.7 detect.py MSVC infra (msvc_ver/scons_version/check_mssdk_version) absent in base; Windows-build-only tooling, no macOS impact. Revisit if the Windows toolchain path is ported.

title: Android: Fix NPE in JavaClassWrapper proxy when interface method has no arguments
orig_rationale: Guards a null args array (args ?: emptyArray()) in the interface-proxy invocation. Depends on the #115498 proxy feature absent from base; rebranded Kotlin, no android build coverage here.

title: Android: Fix infinite recursion in proxy equals handler
orig_rationale: Fixes infinite recursion in the Java interface-proxy equals()/hashCode() handler. Depends on the interface-proxy feature added by #115498 (a490), which is not in base 4.6.3; also lands in the fully rebranded games.cafecito.foundry Kotlin tree and is not build-verified on macOS.

title: macOS: Fix mouse warp for embedded game window
orig_rationale: Trivial Vector2i integer-scaling fix for embedded warp_mouse, but targets display_server_macos_embedded (renamed from base's display_server_embedded by #106814); blocked on that embedded rename/refactor.

title: [macOS] Fix build with enabled ANGLE and disabled Vulkan/Metal.
orig_rationale: Adds Metal framework in ANGLE link branch, but fork base macos detect.py uses a different (older) ANGLE structure and already links Metal for the Metal driver; needs adaptation and is low value.
